snippet.title: Kavenga - Songs of the Star Path: Ra’iatea and Taha’a
snippet.description:
https://doonch.github.io/Kavenga/intro.html

In this game of open ocean navigation, inspired by the great Polynesian navigators of the Pacific, the player must read environmental cues to determine the right way to go. With no map and no compass, the player learns the art of wayfinding by clouds, birds, ocean swells, and the night sky.
